'''Alpha''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kam Solusar]], created by [[Empire of the Hand|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on the orders of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. He was the mate of [[Hunter (clone)|Hunter]] with whom he sired two daughters, [[Blessing]] and [[Grace (Human)|Grace]]. In [[41 ABY]], he was killed on a [[Frozen moon|moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] after a [[Mission to the frozen moon|lightsaber duel]].

[[File:KamSolusarHSr-NEGTC.png|thumb|150px|Kam Solusar, Alpha's genetic "father".]]

==Personality and traits==
Alpha was insane from clone madness, and he had a mad desire to feed and worship the Rakatan entity known as ''Mother''.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==Powers and abilities==
Alpha was an extremely powerful Force-user, shown by the fact that he was selected as the leader of the [[Community]]. When he was faced by Jedi Knight [[Jaden Korr]], Alpha dueled with savage ferocity in his form of lightsaber combat. So much, that Jaden, an experienced Jedi Knight with incredible mastery over both the Light and Dark Sides of the Force, was almost killed in their duel, in the first few minutes. Alpha's Force presence was described as ''that of a dark-side user, but adulterated with something else'', proving the fact that he can use dark and light Side powers.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
[[File:Korr-Riptide.jpg|thumb|Alpha's lightsaber was claimed by Jaden Korr]]

==Equipment and gear==
Like other clones in the secret facility, Alpha was able to steal enough parts to construct his own lightsaber, which may have been what allowed the clones to rebel. [[Jaden Korr]] compared Alpha's lightsaber to the [[Jaden Korr's first lightsaber|purple-bladed lightsaber]] Korr had constructed without training and eventually used to kill Alpha. Alpha's lightsaber was said to be "unstable", and spit sparks when activated. After defeating Alpha, Jaden Korr kept the clone's unstable, red-bladed lightsaber to replace the green-bladed lightsaber he had constructed upon becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], which he had lost in [[Mission to the frozen moon|the duel with Alpha]].<ref name="Crosscurrent" /> Jaden Korr later cleansed the lightsaber of Alpha's Dark residuum left in the crystal. After the cleansing, it turned yellow, as Jaden Korr was thinking of [[Relin Druur]] at the time. The yellow-bladed lightsaber then became Jaden Korr's primary lightsaber, and was said to be a final tribute to Relin Druur's memory.<ref name="Riptide">[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>

Alpha was said to be wearing a combination of rags, doctors' clothing, and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]' armor retrieved from those who were stationed at the facility and were killed when the clones rebelled.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
